text:
Based on the image provided, this does not show a map screen at all. 

Instead, this is the **main title screen** of *The Battle Cats* (showing the standard version 12.6.0 start menu with the "PLAY" button and the signature horde of Cats marching along the bottom). 

Because this is just the title screen and not the Chapter 2 world map, it does not show any geographic landmasses, real-world locations, or the color-shifted Earth map typical of *Into the Future* (Chapter 2). To see the map, you would need to tap "PLAY" and select the second chapter.
